title: Kaderblick help and documentation

hero.heading: Understand and use Kaderblick with confidence
hero.lead: Instructions for the complete club routine—from first access and team and match organisation to reports, finances, equipment and administration.

🛡️
Administration, finance and equipment
User relationships, teams and clubs, bookings, tabs, penalties and equipment.

How the areas connect

Kaderblick does not record all information separately for each area. A team connects players, coaches, appointments, matches and tasks. A match can also connect attendance, line-up, match plan, events, live ticker, video and reports. Changes can therefore appear in several places.

1
Club and team provide context
Assignments determine the people, appointments and content relevant to an account.
2
Appointments organise the work
Training, matches and tasks connect time, location, participants, responses and reminders.
3
A match connects preparation and analysis
Squad and match plan are prepared; events, videos and reports complete the workflow.
ℹ️
Your view may look different
Visible menu items and actions depend on role, assignment and the opened club, team or record. Use “Help by role” if a described function is missing.

Camera systems and accompanying software

✂️

Get support

  1. Open the instructions for the affected area and check the prerequisites.
  2. Compare your role and assignment under Help by role.
  3. Use My feedback in Kaderblick to report a reproducible problem or suggestion.
  4. For missing assignments or permissions, contact the responsible team or club administration.
